subject: SableCore network onboarding & secure ingress sync
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: Ellen Park <ellen.park@sablecore.com>, network-infra@sablecore.com
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 15 Jan 2028 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: SableCore network onboarding & secure ingress sync

Hi Ellen / SableCore infra team —

Thanks again for choosing Redwood for your private inference lane. To keep the onboarding lean, we want to confirm three items before the tech sync:

1) Peering model: do you want static prefix exchange or short-lived BGP sessions?
2) Certificate exchange: we support either PEM bundles or a signed PKCS#12; which format will you provide for mutual TLS?
3) Ingress path: are you planning to use a colocated edge appliance (we ship an "edge package") or prefer a cloud-private-endpoint into your VPC?

I've attached a working draft of our runbook and the current network diagram so your ops folks can scan for obvious mismatches. Can we do a 30-minute tech sync on Wed 1/18 10:00am PT? If that doesn't work, propose two windows and we'll staff accordingly.

Attachments: runbook-draft.md (draft), network-diagram-v2.pdf (diagram)

Thanks — looking forward to a quick alignment.

Jonas Weber
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0192

---
From: Ellen Park <ellen.park@sablecore.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, network-infra@sablecore.com
Date: Mon, 15 Jan 2028 11:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SableCore network onboarding & secure ingress sync

Jonas —

Appreciate the clear list. Quick answers from our infra lead:

1) Static prefix exchange is our preference — we avoid long-running BGP unless necessary for HA.
2) We can provide a PEM bundle (cert + key + intermediate chain). Please confirm preferred filename conventions; we'll zip and send.
3) We will use cloud-private-endpoints into our VPC rather than colocated hardware.

We do have two small constraints to flag up-front:
- Our egress IPs are NATed behind a small pool; we'll send the exact prefixes in the cert bundle email.
- MTU on our peering links is 9000 — if Redwood's edge package reduces MTU we need to know.

We can do Wed 1/18 10:00am PT. I've attached our peering template (stub) so you can pre-fill.

Attachments: sablecore-peering-template.csv (template)

—Ellen
Ellen Park
Head of Infrastructure | SableCore
ellen.park@sablecore.com | +1 650-555-1245

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 16 Jan 2028 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Internal: SableCore sync prep (answers from Ellen)

Monica / Karthik —

Summary from Ellen: static prefixes, PEM cert bundle, cloud-private-endpoints, MTU=9000. They also have NATed egress pool; they'll send exact prefixes.

Actions I propose before Wed sync:
- Karthik: please review the runbook and add a short MTU handling note + our expected cipher suites for mTLS. Also confirm whether our private endpoint option needs any additional IAM/service-account flows.
- Monica: can you pre-populate the acceptance tests in the runbook (smoke checks for TLS handshake, prefix reachability, and a token-auth end-to-end)?

I pre-filled the peering template with the slots we need (IP pairs, CIDRs, allowed ciphers). I'll circulate the updated runbook once Karthik's notes are in.

Jonas

---
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 17 Jan 2028 08:23:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Internal: SableCore sync prep (answers from Ellen)

Adding a few technical points inline:

- MTU: we'll honor 9000 on the private endpoint tunnel; note for the runbook: enable TCP MSS clamping on our side to avoid fragmentation for tunnels that traverse smaller-MTU hops.
- mTLS: we expect PEM with key in separate file; prefer RSA or ECDSA P-256 with SHA256. Add a checklist entry to verify chain ordering.
- Private endpoint flow: yes — we'll need a short-lived role (service account) added to their VPC with a minimal set of permissions to write NAT translations and route health checks. I'll draft the IAM snippet.

I'll add these as tracked edits to runbook-draft.md and flag the sections in the diagram where the endpoint sits.

Karthik
Principal Network Architect | Redwood Inference

---
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: Ellen Park <ellen.park@sablecore.com>, network-infra@sablecore.com
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 17 Jan 2028 12:10:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SableCore network onboarding & secure ingress sync

Ellen —

Thanks for the quick responses. Per Karthik's note, we'll:
- Honor MTU=9000 and enable MSS clamping where we cross smaller-MTU hops.
- Expect a PEM bundle (cert + key + chain) in a zip; please name the zip "sablecore-cert-bundle.zip" and include a short readme with contact names.
- We'll provide a minimal IAM role template for the private endpoint flow in the runbook update.

I've attached the updated network diagram that highlights the private endpoint placement and the acceptance tests section in the runbook (draft). Meeting invite for Wed 1/18 10:00am PT has been sent.

Attachments: network-diagram-v2.pdf (updated) , runbook-draft.md (updated)

See you Wed.

Jonas

From: Ellen Park <ellen.park@sablecore.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 19 Jan 2028 16:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SableCore network onboarding & secure ingress sync

Jonas / team —

Great sync today — thanks for walking through the flow. Quick follow-ups from our side:

- Attached is the cert bundle (sablecore-cert-bundle.zip) and our accepted prefixes file (sablecore-prefixes.csv).
- We validated the MTU and there are no intermediaries that will reduce below 9000 on the intended path.
- Acceptance test plan: we'll run the TLS handshake + token-auth smoke test from our staging VPC against your private endpoint on Jan 25 and report back by EOD.

We are comfortable moving the peering to the scheduled maintenance window on Jan 25. If anything changes we will flag it in the HS-22134 track.

Attachments: sablecore-cert-bundle.zip (certs), sablecore-prefixes.csv (prefixes), acceptance-plan.txt (plan)

Thanks — Ellen

Ellen Park
Head of Infrastructure | SableCore
ellen.park@sablecore.com
